body:
## Summary

- Add **collection-report admission path** (`admitCollectionReportOrder`) wiring resolution revalidation, gate-leak recipe compilation (worst-case ≤160 nodes), and CR-201C `admitOrder` in one intake flow.
- Extend intake envelope schema with **`client_request_id`**; idempotent replay returns the same order; reuse with different body returns **`idempotency_conflict`** before digest validation.
- Add deterministic **gate-leak recipe compiler** + composition helper; wire admission capacity in `bin/http.ts`.

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm test src/__tests__/collection-report-intake.test.ts` — 5 pass (idempotency, conflict, digest mismatch, resolution expired, client_request_id required)
- [x] `pnpm test src/__tests__/gate-leak-recipe-compiler.test.ts` — 5 pass (catalog, ≤160 bound, overflow rejection, determinism)
- [ ] CI green on ordering-service package

## Gaps / follow-ups

- User-visible state mapping lives in existing `collection-report-projection.ts` (CR-206); no new projection tests in this PR.
- `invalid_recipe_expansion` quarantine path and upstream evidence DAG expansion are orchestrator/runtime concerns — not covered here.
- Public-preparation adapter/worker (CR-204A) intentionally excluded from this branch.

      "id": "F1",
      "title": "additional_root_work_keys ignored; ownership_index never joined",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "category": "correctness",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/collection-report-admission.ts:312",
      "description": "buildPublicRootWorkKeysFromResolution returns collection_identity.v1 then ownership_index.v1, but AdmitOrderInput only accepts work_key. additional_root_work_keys is not part of the CR-201C admitOrder API and is dropped at the call site. Only the first key (collection_identity.v1) is joined, while pool_scope.capability is ownership_index.v1 — the opposite of existing admission fixtures, which default the joined work_key to ownership_index.v1. Gate Leak public prep therefore admits without an ownership_index shared-work join.",
      "suggestion": "Extend AdmitOrderInput/admitOrder to join every public root work key, or pass ownership_index.v1 as work_key (matching pool_scope) and join collection_identity in the same transaction. Remove the dead additional_root_work_keys field until the store supports it; add an intake assertion that both public roots exist as active preparation links.",
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "title": "Public-auth lease denials collapsed to resolution_scope_mismatch",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "category": "security",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/collection-report-admission.ts:221",
      "description": "On acquireLease failure, the previous intake path returned mapDenial's status and body (401/403/409 with the CR-007A denial envelope). This path forces status 403 via `as 403`, sets code to resolution_scope_mismatch, and stuffs mapped.body.code into reason. Unauthorized and idempotency_conflict lease outcomes are mislabeled and the structured denial body is lost.",
      "suggestion": "Propagate mapDenial status/body unchanged (or map safe_code onto CollectionReportAdmissionErrorCode 1:1). Do not cast status to 403 or overwrite the denial code.",
      "confidence": 0.98
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",

      "severity": "HIGH",
      "category": "reliability",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/collection-report-admission.ts:233",
      "description": "resolutionStore.get runs before getIdempotency. A successful first admit that later loses its resolution row (TTL eviction, purge) causes replay of the same client_request_id to return 409 resolution_not_found instead of the prior order_id/replay=true from admitOrder.",
      "suggestion": "Check admissionCapacity.store.getIdempotency first; on hit with matching body, call admitOrder (or return the stored order_id) without requiring resolution revalidation. Only load/admit the resolution when no idempotency row exists.",

      "category": "reliability",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/admission-capacity-composition.ts:28",
      "description": "createAdmissionCapacityComposition reuses the order store pool for PostgresSharedPreparationStore, but PostgresAdmissionCapacityStore.connect always constructs `new pg.Pool({ connectionString, max: 10 })` even when preparationStore is provided. Production http wiring therefore doubles DB pool capacity for the same process.",
      "suggestion": "Add an optional pool parameter to PostgresAdmissionCapacityStore.connect (mirroring the preparation store) and pass store.getPool() from the composition helper.",
      "confidence": 0.92
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "title": "Empty selection yields unmapped 500 from compiler",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "category": "correctness",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/collection-report-admission.ts:268",
      "description": "deploymentCount uses `selected_deployment_ids?.length ?? 0`. compileGateLeakRecipe throws a plain Error for non-positive counts; mapCollectionReportAdmissionError does not map it, so the catch rethrows and intake surfaces a 500 instead of a 409 admission denial (e.g. missing_confirmation / selection_stale).",
      "suggestion": "Deny with missing_confirmation (or selection_stale) when selected_deployment_ids is missing/empty before compileGateLeakRecipe, and/or map the positive-count Error in mapCollectionReportAdmissionError.",
      "confidence": 0.75
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "title": "Replay still invokes onPlaced/orchestrator.process",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "category": "reliability",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/intake.ts:184",
      "description": "Successful collection-report responses always call deps.onPlaced(order_id), including admitResult.replay === true. bin/http.ts wires onPlaced to orchestrator.process, so idempotent client retries re-enter fulfillment. The processor is mostly state-gated, but concurrent replay while still `placed` can race duplicate transitions.",
      "suggestion": "Call onPlaced only when replay is false (or when admitResult indicates created/work_created).",
      "confidence": 0.7
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "title": "capacity_weight fixed at 2 while only one work key is reserved",
      "severity": "SPECULATION",
      "category": "correctness",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/gate-leak-recipe-compiler.ts:94",
      "description": "Certificate capacity_weight is GATE_LEAK_PUBLIC_NODES_PER_DEPLOYMENT (2). admitOrder consumes certificate.capacity_weight on the queued_work ledger for the single joined work_key. CR-201C fixtures use capacity_weight 1 with one ownership_index key. If both public roots were meant to be joined, weight 2 matches; with only one join, queued capacity is over-charged by 2x relative to envelopes created.",
      "suggestion": "Set capacity_weight to the number of root work keys actually joined in the admit transaction (1 today, 2 once both roots join), and cover accounting in intake tests.",
      "confidence": 0.55
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "title": "Compiler tier flag is a no-op",
      "severity": "LOW",
      "category": "maintainability",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/gate-leak-recipe-compiler.ts:69",
      "description": "CompileGateLeakRecipeInput.tier accepts \"public\" | \"full\" but compileGateLeakRecipe never branches on it; worst-case always includes restricted community nodes and identity-link pages.",
      "suggestion": "Omit tier until T2, or assert tier === \"public\" and reject \"full\" so callers cannot assume a narrower bound.",
      "confidence": 0.85
    },
    {
      "id": "F9",
      "title": "Tests mutate private ResolutionStore internals",
      "severity": "LOW",
      "category": "testing",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/__tests__/collection-report-intake.test.ts:78",
      "description": "seedResolution casts InMemoryResolutionStore to `{ records: Map }` and writes directly. Refactors of the in-memory store will break tests without a compile error.",
      "suggestion": "Add a test-only put/seed method on InMemoryResolutionStore (or use the public write path used in production).",
      "confidence": 0.8
    },
    {
      "id": "F10",
      "title": "Unused LocalCapabilitySnapshot import",
      "severity": "LOW",
      "category": "maintainability",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/collection-report-admission.ts:10",
      "description": "LocalCapabilitySnapshot is imported as a type but never referenced in the module.",
      "suggestion": "Remove the unused import.",
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "F11",
      "title": "Deterministic bound-checked recipe compiler",
      "severity": "PRAISE",
      "category": "design",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/gate-leak-recipe-compiler.ts:69",
      "description": "Fixed node-type catalog plus explicit SelectionTooLargeError/WorkflowTooLargeError before admitOrder keeps V1 ceilings (≤16 deployments, ≤160 nodes, ≤32 roots) enforceable at compile time with deterministic certificates.",
      "suggestion": "Keep the compiler as the single source of certificate material for collection-report admit; extend tests once multi-root join is wired.",
      "confidence": 0.9
    },
    {
      "id": "F12",
      "title": "Admission path extraction with focused deny coverage",
      "severity": "PRAISE",
      "category": "design",
      "file": "packages/services/ordering/src/intake.ts:164",
      "description": "Moving collection-report placement into admitCollectionReportOrder and covering idempotent replay, idempotency_conflict, candidate_digest_mismatch, resolution_expired, and client_request_id_required keeps intake thin and regressions observable.",
      "suggestion": "Add cases for lease-denial status passthrough and multi-root preparation links once F1/F2 are fixed.",

    }
